name: lift_lift_assoc
statement: C} {B : C} [MonObj B] (f g h : A ⟶ B) : lift (lift f g ≫ μ) h ≫ μ = lift f (lift g h ≫ μ) ≫ μ

have_tree.body: lift (lift f g) h ≫= mul_assoc B

name: lift_comp_one_left
statement: C} {B : C} [MonObj B] (f : A ⟶ 𝟙_ C) (g : A ⟶ B) : lift (f ≫ η) g ≫ μ = g

name: lift_comp_one_right
statement: C} {B : C} [MonObj B] (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ 𝟙_ C) : lift f (g ≫ η) ≫ μ = f
